# netbox_rack_reservations (Data Source)

Lists rack_reservation objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_rack_reservations" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: created, created__empty, created__gt, created__gte, created__lt, created__lte, created__n, description, description__empty, description__ic, description__ie, description__iew, description__iregex, description__isw, description__n, description__nic, description__nie, description__niew, description__nisw, description__regex, group, group__n, group_id, group_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, last_updated, last_updated__empty, last_updated__gt, last_updated__gte, last_updated__lt, last_updated__lte, last_updated__n, location, location__n, location_id, location_id__n, owner, owner__n, owner_group, owner_group__n, owner_group_id, owner_group_id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, q, rack_id, rack_id__n, region, region__n, region_id, region_id__n, site, site__n, site_group, site_group__n, site_group_id, site_group_id__n, site_id, site_id__n, status, status__empty, status__ic, status__ie, status__iew, status__iregex, status__isw, status__n, status__nic, status__nie, status__niew, status__nisw, status__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n, tag_id, tag_id__any, tag_id__n, tenant, tenant__n, tenant_group, tenant_group__n, tenant_group_id, tenant_group_id__n, tenant_id, tenant_id__n, unit, unit__empty, unit__gt, unit__gte, unit__lt, unit__lte, unit__n, unit_count_max, unit_count_min, user, user__n, user_id, user_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `rack_reservations` (Attributes List) The matching rack_reservations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rack_reservations))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--rack_reservations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rack_reservations`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. An object field holds the related object's id, e.g. "12", a multiobject field a JSON list of ids in any order, e.g. jsonencode([12, 13]). A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String) Purpose of the reservation.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `rack_id` (Number) Id of the rack.
- `status` (String) Status of the reservation. One of: pending, active, stale.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `unit_count` (Number) Number of rack units reserved.
- `units` (Set of Number) Rack unit numbers being reserved.
- `url` (String)
- `user_id` (Number) Id of the NetBox user holding the reservation.
